decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 17th January 2006, the matter described above is lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:
The private hire vehicle operator involves the use of a small space in the existing house as an office area.  It required no internal or external alterations to the property, no external signage has been erected and it attracts no business related clients to site.  The scale and nature of the business use is therefore considered ancillary to the residential use, with the property continuing as a dwellinghouse and, as it does not result in a material change of use to part or whole of the dwelling, planning permission is not required.
Condition : 2 - Informative
The certificate hereby granted for the use of an area of the house as a private hire vehicle operator is for the purposes of a booking centre only, and shall not be used as a centre for drivers or customers.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the proposed use of one room for private hire vehicle operator
